subreddits.title: Subreddits
subreddits.description: Subreddit names, e.g. SillyTavernAI (no r/ prefix). Fetched from Reddit's Atom feed - no proxy needed. Leave empty to skip Reddit.

reddit_timeframe.title: Reddit timeframe
reddit_timeframe.description: Reddit's own 't' query param for the top listing. Enforced server-side by Reddit.

substack_publications.title: Substack publication URLs
substack_publications.description: Publication URLs (https://name.substack.com), custom domains, or reader-profile links (https://substack.com/@handle). Tracking query params are stripped automatically. A profile link has no feed of its own, so the handle is also tried against name.substack.com - check the log for 'substack: fell back to' to see which URL actually served.

max_items_per_source.title: Max items per source
max_items_per_source.description: Caps the number of items taken per subreddit and per publication, before the age filter is applied.

max_age_days.title: Only keep items newer than N days
max_age_days.description: Drops items older than N days. Set 0 to disable. Reddit enforces recency server-side via reddit_timeframe, but Substack's RSS has no equivalent - it serves the most recent entries however old they are, so a dormant publication would otherwise contribute year-old posts. Items with no parseable date are kept, since a missing date is not evidence of being old.

summary_max_chars.title: Summary length budget
summary_max_chars.description: Characters kept per item's summary. Was hard-coded to 500 through v0.10, which discarded almost all of a long self-post - one measured Reddit post carried 14,360 characters of body.

filter_titles.title: Drop entries matching these patterns
filter_titles.description: Case-insensitive regexes matched against title + summary; matching entries are dropped. Best-effort only. Reddit's Atom feed carries no over_18 flag (verified against a live feed), so the NSFW filtering the old JSON path did cannot be reproduced.

fail_on_empty_source.title: Fail the run if any requested source returns nothing
fail_on_empty_source.description: If subreddits were requested and produced 0 rows, or publications were requested and produced 0 rows, fail the run instead of exiting successfully with a partial or empty dataset. Replaces the Reddit-only 'require_reddit' guard, which let a total Substack failure exit 0 silently (observed 2026-08-11).

require_reddit.title: DEPRECATED - exempt Reddit from the empty-source check
require_reddit.description: Deprecated. Set to false to exempt Reddit specifically from fail_on_empty_source, e.g. if you expect a subreddit to be dormant.

reddit_strategy_override.title: Force one strategy (diagnostics)
reddit_strategy_override.description: Leave empty for normal operation (walk the ordered list, first success wins). Set to a single spec to test just that one.
